variants.ah.png: Conversational open AH mouth, localized edit of all eight master mouths
variants.oo.png: Rounded OO mouth, localized edit of all eight master mouths
variants.blink.png: Gently closed eyelids, localized edit of all eight master faces
variants.smile.png: Restrained closed-lip smile with coordinated cheeks and eyes
variants.angry.png: Frustrated/determined brows, eyes and cheeks with closed lips
variants.afraid.png: Alarmed/worried eyes and brows with closed lips

method: Built-in imagegen edits of the neutral atlas, requested to preserve dimensions, cell positions, identity, hair and clothing. Generated results are not claimed to preserve every pixel.
runtime: tools/prepare-flight-portraits.ps1 applies per-character calibration offline and packs seven 256px poses per runtime/portrait-N.png. Flight warms the sixteen pilot bitmaps sequentially in background idle time, with foreground caller priority. Pose rectangles are composited directly, without persistent per-pose canvases. Page exit closes the fixed seventeen-bitmap cache (Control loads on demand). Original source PNGs are preserved. Only masked inner-face pixels can enter the master portrait; no runtime generation or external network dependencies.

expanded_cast.method: Nine built-in imagegen character sheets, using neutral.png as a style reference; prompt set recorded in cast/prompts.json. Row-major frames: neutral, ah, oo, blink, smile, angry, afraid, unused neutral.
